![VirusTotal]({{ $env.WEBHOOK_URL }}
## Webhook Node 
To setup your webhook integration for Splunk, first ensure that splunk is setup to send alerts to a webhook by visiting the [Setup Guide here]({{ $env.WEBHOOK_URL }} You will copy the n8n webhook url opening the webhook node below. 
- **Form Access URLs**:
  - **Execute Mode**: `{{ $env.WEBHOOK_URL }}` - Use this to execute the workflow interactively within the n8n canvas. Hit the 'Execute Workflow' button to see real-time execution results. We have pinned data in the webhook node to make testing easier. 
  - **Silent Mode**: `{{ $env.WEBHOOK_URL }}` - Use this for background execution without canvas updates. Results will be logged silently and can be reviewed in the 'Executions' tab.
